verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS email product, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The MCP server (docs-10, probe-3) is a pull-based tool interface. The trigger-based agents (docs-61) are internal automation, not webhooks. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probe-2, probe-1). These adjacent features earn no credit toward this story.
